item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00470","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C15","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a concrete commendation-letter template: praise an organization's completed work, express personal gratification, and ask the recipient to convey the President's commendation to all participants, ending with the distinctive phrase \"a job well done.\" The child closely reproduces that sequence and language while adapting it to the concluding work of a different committee. C15 and C17 share the thanks-for-service formulation and the same closing phrase, but lack C04's stronger request to transmit praise to the wider staff or membership.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I, personally, have been extremely gratified at the splendid way in which the Committee and its staff have carried out their responsibilities.","parent_excerpt":"I know you share my feelings of gratification at the accomplishments of the Commission's Los Alamos Scientific Laboratory","explanation":"Both express presidential gratification at the accomplishments of the body being commended."},{"child_excerpt":"Please extend my good wishes and gratitude to every member of the Committee and its staff for a job well done.","parent_excerpt":"Please convey to the Commander of Join Task Force Seven and to all of the member of the National Military Establishment who contributed to the success of the undertaking my commendation for a job well done.","explanation":"This is a distinctive shared closing instruction: the addressee is asked to transmit commendation to all participants, using the identical phrase \"for a job well done.\""},{"child_excerpt":"The members of the President's Committee on Religion and Welfare in the Armed Forces deserve the thanks of the entire Nation for the work they have accomplished","parent_excerpt":"The Chairman and members of the Commission join me in congratulations to you on the work of Joint Task Force Seven which carried out the tests for the Commission.","explanation":"Both open by commending members for successfully completed institutional work."}]}
